proves.claim: with claim.checkCeiling on, claim refuses CHECK_OVER_CEILING for an item whose recorded check measured over the frozen ceiling and leaves it open and unclaimed.

cli.io-claim.check-ceiling-refuses-over.why: Without it a check too slow for the landing timeout is claimed, built and only fails at the gate.

proves.claim: with the setting on, a pending or unmeasured baseline is claimed, and with it off or unset an over-ceiling item is claimed as today.

cli.io-claim.check-ceiling-claims-pendin.why: Without it the new refusal could block items it has no measurement for, or change claims on boards that did not opt in.
